task: E-2 independent re-check of fixtures without a pick
method: Each fixture still without a compliant pick was re-checked against the rules the pipeline applies (scripts/originate.py ladder: Polymarket, Kalshi, Thunderpick, Bovada, Pinnacle, EGamersWorld aggregate, Valve official standings, HLTV world ranking, own results model). Nothing here changes a published value. Original HLTV/Valve/Hotspawn pages were read through the fetch tool or are saved in-repo; saved evidence paths are given where they exist.

fixtures.label: ex-CYBERSHOKE vs BlinkDagger (CIS LAN Championship #9)

checks.finding: Valve ranking and world ranking shown as '-'; roster: 'no active players in their lineup'; 'Recent results: Couldn't find any recent results'; 'has not played any matches yet'.
Valve and world ranking shown as '-'; roster: 'does not currently have a roster'; the newest listed result is dated 2020 (outside the 120-day window).
Shows ex-CYBERSHOKE 'HLTV: Unranked' and 'VRS: #78'. #78 in the 2026-10-05 Valve file is Lazer Cats, not CYBERSHOKE. This conflicts with the team page's '-'.
Shows a '74.6% / 25.4%' split labelled 'Pick a winner'. This is a community vote, not a bookmaker line, so it is not used (same rule as Hotspawn '% picked').

checks.check: Valve official standings 2026-10-05 (latest published; live/2026 directory listed via GitHub API)
checks.finding: 'CYBERSHOKE' appears twice as a complete five-player row: standing 61 (Alkaren, alpha, Mokuj1n, nota, yiksrezo) and standing 171 (alpha, bl1x1, fluffy, glowiing, Mokuj1n). 'BlinkDagger' is absent.
CYBERSHOKE appears at #91 (9 points). BlinkDagger does not appear among the 245 ranked positions, so the world-ranking rung cannot price this pair.

fixtures.why_blank: Identity is ambiguous in Valve data (two complete CYBERSHOKE rosters, neither confirmed by a current HLTV lineup). BlinkDagger has no Valve row and no world ranking. Its HLTV history is outside the 120-day window, so the own results model has no input. No bookmaker line was found.

reference_to_rules: scripts/originate.py and scripts/form_model.py: a rating rung needs both teams; the results model needs at least 8 finished series against at least 3 rated opponents in 120 days.

The fixture rows themselves were not re-read from the Hotspawn API in this session (the feed is large); the fixture IDs and names come from the live site's published rows.
No browser was available, so the rendered mobile layout was not re-tested in this session.
